entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: 成功は、blind/sequestered状態と許可affordance、外部化行動、汚染・loophole所見を参照解決可能な構造で記録し、集計を再現し、違反・不足をgovernanceへ送ること。npm test、負例fixture全件、AOF verify全件が通り、v0.6.42タグとGitHub Releaseが公開されること。
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The broad continuation request is reframed into the evaluation-validity gap after judge robustness: a judge trial is not trustworthy merely because its arithmetic is reproducible when answers, labels, grader behavior, or loopholes may be available to the evaluated actor.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: The committed run is example-only with unknown blindness; independent sequestered infrastructure, secret cases, live actor execution, adversarial review, and representative empirical evidence remain outside this release.
entries.expectation_state: Schema, example, verifier, 39 retained negative fixtures, plain-language documentation, roadmap, and release notes implement the approved three-entity sequestered replay lifecycle; npm test passes 16/16 positive and 1064/1064 negative checks.
entries.mismatch_state: The committed run is example-only with unknown blindness; independent sequestered infrastructure, secret cases, live actor execution, adversarial review, and representative empirical evidence remain outside this release.
entries.scale_direction: Run Council review and organization verification, publish v0.6.42, then begin v0.6.43 cross-judge correlated-error design.
